# Osmos

> Osmos is a local-first, peer-to-peer version control system designed for designers, writers, and teams to privately, locally, and rapidly version and sync files. Operating entirely without central cloud servers, Osmos guarantees complete data ownership, privacy, and immediate local performance.

Osmos replaces central cloud repositories with direct peer-to-peer syncing across local networks, providing real-time version history, automatic backups, and seamless Git interoperability.

- [Open Source](https://useosmos.com/open-source/): Open-source core licensing and community guidelines
